quests.title: The Court's Own Copy
quests.premise: A certified copy of a land grant goes missing from the Records Court. It goes missing in the week when its hearing is listed.

quests.title: Weights of the Fourth Kind
quests.premise: Argonian carts weigh heavy at the toll tower. Nibenese carts with the same load do not weigh heavy.

quests.title: Waiting, They Call It
quests.premise: A debtor is held in a grated pit behind a broker's yard. The broker renegotiates his Owing without him.

quests.title: What the Ditch Kept
quests.premise: The pay chest of an abandoned road fort lies under the flooded ground floor. The garrison's last muster lies beside the chest.

quests.title: The Licence and the Lid
quests.premise: Cyrodilic Collections holds a licence to dig certain ground. The nearest village holds a burial claim over that ground.

quests.title: Jars Out of Order
quests.premise: Specimen jars leave the field station for the city. They arrive short by one crate a month.

quests.title: The Duke's Standing Water
quests.premise: Something in the ducal ruin repeats the last week of a siege, in order. It does so for a traveller who beds down inside the lines.

quests.title: Nine Wells, Eight Answers
quests.premise: Eight of the ring's nine wells give plain water. The ninth well gives back what was said over it.

quests.title: The Hand-Read Hall
quests.premise: A ruin has inscriptions cut to be read by touch. The ruin answers only a reader who cannot see.

quests.title: Carrying for the Cartwright
quests.premise: A porter relay's whole string of nine men fails to arrive. The carts are found parked and loaded.

quests.title: The Cold Forge Bargain
quests.premise: A smithy has a fire that gives no heat. The smithy works for a customer who can name the use of the metal.

quests.title: Two Empires, One Cellar
quests.premise: An officeholder's house passes to two claimants. Two bodies of law both apply here.

quests.title: The Marble Field Sale
quests.premise: A foreign graveyard's plots are being resold. They are resold to families who paid for them a century ago.

quests.title: Bones on the Wrong Road
quests.premise: A bundle was booked for the western repatriation road. It turns up counted into a mass grave instead.

quests.title: Rootworm, Out of Season
quests.premise: The seasonal rootworm terminus must be opened out of season. A cargo cannot wait for winter.

quests.title: The Synod's Second Question
quests.premise: The Reckoning House has asked for a survey of the gate scar. The villagers have declined to allow a survey for two hundred years.

quests.title: Clay for the Court
quests.premise: The city's kiln contract is up. Two yards are bidding, with one river landing between them.

quests.title: The Fair Outside the Gate
quests.premise: Goods taxed at the gate appear untaxed on the fair ground. The fair ground lies a kilometre outside the gate.

quests.title: Kwama and Consequence
quests.premise: Mine water is reaching the paddies below the mine. The crop is failing in a widening wedge.

quests.title: The Ferryman's Count
quests.premise: The ferry family's tally of crossings is three higher than the toll house's tally of arrivals.

quests.title: Levy in Correct Phrasing
quests.premise: A Legion officer must decide whether to offer a pardon. The men concerned still keep a Legion duty roster.

quests.title: The Turned-Out Verge
quests.premise: An evicted household is camped in sight of its old fields. The household has a title deed. The estate steward will not read the deed.

quests.title: Withdrawal House Rules
quests.premise: A house that dries out skooma users is being blamed for a sickness. The sickness started elsewhere.

quests.title: The Buried Spears
quests.premise: A weapon cache was buried against a war that ended. People who expect another war are digging it up.

quests.title: Silver Mouth, Silver Tongue
quests.premise: A dealer in Gideon sells Kothringi grave silver. He has provenance papers for a site he has not entered.

quests.title: The Chapel of Two Months
quests.premise: Two calendars set the same festival eleven days apart. One chapel and one priest serve both calendars.

quests.title: Still Cordoned
quests.premise: A plague cordon has stood unlifted for three hundred years. It still turns travellers back. The stones are all that enforce it.

quests.title: Under the Crown
quests.premise: A climb to a Barsaebic roof is the way into a compound. The dig licence sealed the compound's ground doors.

quests.title: The Black Tarn Wager
quests.premise: Gideon's hunting trade will pay for proof of what takes boats off the tarn. It will also pay for the creature's head.

quests.title: The Records Court Flood
quests.premise: The archive floods every wet season. An agent must find which lock failed before the next flood.

quests.title: Makes-And-Burns
quests.premise: A season's work is made to be destroyed at its close. A patron wants a single piece from this year kept.

quests.title: The Rockpoint Claim
quests.premise: A derelict landing's owner left for Stormhold. The landing goes to whoever satisfies three separate offices.

quests.title: Figs, Counted Twice
quests.premise: The market's own weighing clerk keeps two tally boards for the same stalls.

quests.title: The Hollow Under the Figs
quests.premise: A root gallery under the fig mats has opened into the market's storage pits.

quests.title: Poachers at the Fig Camp
quests.premise: A camp works the fig country. The camp takes more than fruit. The market buys whatever the camp brings.

quests.title: The Guar That Was Owed
quests.premise: A herd is pledged against a debt. Neither the lender nor the borrower is grazing the herd.

quests.title: Nine Bells, No Ringer
quests.premise: A herdsman died in the spring. The holding's bells are still rung on time every night.

quests.title: A Buyer for the Back Kiln
quests.premise: A fermentary off the books needs a market stall. The market wants a cut that the fermentary cannot record.

quests.title: The Standing Mist
quests.premise: A hollow west of the market holds mist. The mist does not move with the wind.

quests.title: Ledge of Tallies
quests.premise: Smugglers' tally marks on a cliff ledge name Fig Market traders. The traders deny the debts.

quests.title: The Fig and the Fever
quests.premise: Fruit from one quarter of the fig country is making buyers shake. The sellers refuse to say which trees.

quests.title: Market Rights, Market Wrongs
quests.premise: The market charter falls due for renewal. The road stage's owner claims the right to hold the charter instead.

quests.title: The Sermon Overflow
quests.premise: The pilgrim camp lies a mile short of the shrine. It has become a village. The shrine will not feed the village.

quests.title: Rests-The-Walkers
quests.premise: A death-speaker's rest house has stopped receiving walkers.

quests.title: Under the Sermon Xanmeer
quests.premise: The sermon is preached over a sealed chamber. The chamber's occupant answers on certain nights.

quests.title: Dreams In Mud
quests.premise: Two Gideon visitors came out of the wallow different. The keeper is still taking bookings.

quests.title: The Bridge Toll of Reeds
quests.premise: The reed bridge's toll is paid in bundles. The new tollkeeper wants coin.

quests.title: A Priest for the Second Shrine
quests.premise: The shrine's succession is contested. The claimants are a trained Nisswo and the woman who has done the work for ten years.

quests.title: Whose Water Is Blessed
quests.premise: Shrine water sold to pilgrims is drawn from below the monsoon barrier. It is not drawn from above the barrier.

quests.title: The Pilgrim Who Did Not Arrive
quests.premise: A pilgrim's pack reaches the shrine on the stage cart. The pilgrim does not arrive.

quests.title: Counting the Sermon Road
quests.premise: Hackwings have learned the sermon road's timetable. They know it better than the pilgrims do.

quests.title: The Gate That Closes the Road
quests.premise: The monsoon barrier must be opened early for a shrine convoy. The flood will otherwise strand the convoy.

quests.title: Four Winds, One Door
quests.premise: An insular village admits outsiders through one household. The household's head charges for the privilege.

quests.title: The Knapping Floor
quests.premise: Worked stone from the village floor is being sold in Gideon. The sellers pass it off as Ayleid work.

quests.title: The Leaning Watch
quests.premise: An abandoned watchtower lights its basket on the nights when the village has a death.

quests.title: Silence for the Stone-Talkers
quests.premise: Two stone-speaking villages will not talk to one another. Both need the same pass kept open.

quests.title: The Ridge Runners' Bag
quests.premise: A courier post's sealed bag is opened between stages. It is resealed with a better seal.

quests.title: Scree and Consequence
quests.premise: Something has driven the roost down onto the village's upper terraces.

quests.title: What the Company Stacked
quests.premise: A stack of seized goods lies above the fort road. It still carries the cart marks of Stonewastes households.

quests.title: The Pass Shelter Ledger
quests.premise: The shelter's arrivals book records a party of four leaving. Only three arrived.

quests.title: The Village That Counts Strangers
quests.premise: Stonewastes keeps a tally of every outsider since its founding. The count is now one short.

quests.title: Held, But Not By the Empire
quests.premise: The fort above the town answers to a toll company. The toll company has no writ to hold the fort.

quests.title: The Shadow Line
quests.premise: A body is found on the street at the hour when the fort's shadow crosses it. This has happened for the third month running.

quests.title: Signals for Legions Gone
quests.premise: The signal tower's fire code is being answered from a station. The code does not list that station.

quests.title: Billeted Without Orders
quests.premise: Company hands billet themselves in town houses. They cannot produce a right to do so.

quests.title: The Smithy's Quiet Contract
quests.premise: The town smith's forge books record iron worked. The books show more iron than the bog workings delivered.

quests.title: Bog Iron, Deeper Pools
quests.premise: The diggers have stopped working the deep end of the seep. They give no reason.

quests.title: Takes-The-Field
quests.premise: A blackguard camp is supplied from inside the town. The supply is on the company's account.

quests.title: The Quarantine That Stayed Shut
quests.premise: The town has put a house under quarantine. The house is kept shut for a debt and not for a sickness.

quests.title: Xi-Tsei, Counted
quests.premise: The massacre ground has a yearly count. The count has been read out wrongly for a generation.

quests.title: Dues at the Crossing
quests.premise: The crossing's dues are collected twice. One collection is lawful. Men in the same coats make the other collection.

quests.title: The Wheelwright's Daughter
quests.premise: A wheelwright's daughter left for the mile house at noon. She reached neither end of the road.

quests.title: The Westernmost Hist
quests.premise: No speaker has been chosen for Fenmarch's tree in two years. The village is split over who may ask the tree.

quests.title: Sap and Licence
quests.premise: A tapper has drawn sap from the westernmost Hist at night. The tree's people can taste the change.

quests.title: The Village at the Marsh's Limit
quests.premise: Whatever lights the lake arm has begun coming up the ditches. It is coming into the village.

quests.title: The Stone-Speaker's Grudge
quests.premise: A stone-speaker gave a judgement forty years ago. The judgement is being enforced against a grandchild.

quests.title: The Terrace That Was Swept
quests.premise: The tended xanmeer has a terrace. The village sweeps the terrace nightly. The village says it stopped sweeping years ago.

quests.title: Two Ladders, One Wall
quests.premise: The upper shelf of a gorge community has cut the ladders to its lower shelf. The cause is an unpaid Owing.

quests.title: Washed Out at the Vellum
quests.premise: The estate's washed-out labourers are owed three seasons' wages. The house that owes them keeps immaculate books.

quests.title: The Survey's Neat Edge
quests.premise: The chains and notes of a second survey camp lie where the first party left them. The camp is in ground that the maps omit.

quests.title: Granary on Staddle Stones
quests.premise: Westfield's shared granary is short by a measured amount each week. The seals are intact.

quests.title: The Burnt Field's Hearth
quests.premise: A villager keeps the hearth of the burn-scar village alight. The villager will not be seen doing it.

quests.title: The Well and the Landing
quests.premise: The Imperial well and the Argonian landing serve the same travellers. The well and the landing collect payment under two sets of charges.

quests.title: Hangs-Above-The-Water
quests.premise: The lowest walkway of a gorge-wall village has gone. Three households are on the far side of the gap.

quests.title: Highwater, Low Season
quests.premise: The dry-season wells of the hamlet taste of the drowned farmstead. The farmstead lies upstream.

quests.title: The Raft That Would Not Moor
quests.premise: A Lowmere household's raft keeps drifting to a landing. The town abandoned that landing to crocodiles.

quests.title: Marcian's Terrace, Marcian's Debt
quests.premise: The founding family of the terrace village has died out. Three sets of papers name three heirs.

quests.title: Stonefoot's Second Path
quests.premise: Loads move at night along a path off the terrace village. Those loads are not grown on the terrace.

quests.title: The Doors on the Wall
quests.premise: A shelf household is found dead behind a barred door. The door is sixty metres up a gorge wall.
